response.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.riskeval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval
